metrics.why: Slides that show the numbers instead of listing them
Average words on a slide: less to read, more to see
Slides with more than five bullets
A designed file where every slide passed the layout checks
Average seconds per brief (shorter is better)

method: 8 realistic business briefs (investment memo, sales review, market entry, launch plan, cost programme, hiring plan, churn analysis, capex proposal), the same flagship model (C1) at the same effort. 'On its own' is the model asked directly to write the deck in the chat; it returns slide text and Markdown tables, not a designed file. 'Wrexlyn' is the same model through Wrexlyn's design-and-review pipeline, rendered in the default dark theme. Measured automatically, not hand-scored. Neither side used a figure that isn't in the brief or can't be worked out from it (0 and 0). Results vary with the brief and the engine you connect.
